title: Marlowe Rewards Benefit Schedule: Consolidation Move Limits
content:
In a Gift Cards & Store Credit consolidation of value carried onto a card by replacement, the move limit follows the holder's Marlowe Rewards standing on the consolidation date.

| Marlowe Rewards tier on the consolidation date | Membership enrolled at least | Move limit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Gold, Platinum, Icon or Atelier | 24 whole months earlier | 150.00 |
| Silver | 12 whole months earlier | 100.00 |
| Any other tier or tenure, or no membership | — | Not raised by Marlowe Rewards standing |

Tier and enrolment date are read from the holder's Marlowe Rewards membership; tenure is counted in whole months from the enrolment date to the consolidation date.

## Both conditions together (hypothetical holders)

| Tier | Whole months since enrolment | Move limit under this schedule |
|---|---|---|
| Icon | 24 | 150.00 |
| Gold | 23 | Not raised |
| Silver | 12 | 100.00 |
| Silver | 11 | Not raised |
| Platinum | 15 | Not raised (below 24 months; the 12-month line is for Silver members only) |
| Member (entry tier) | 48 | Not raised |
